topics.focus: Main/principal verb identification; action/state verbs; transitive vs intransitive; verb as doer of action; NOT tense filling or question tags.

Helping verbs: be (am/is/are/was/were), do (do/does/did), have (has/have/had); modals (can, may, must, shall, should, will, would); primary vs modal auxiliary; NOT question-tag or reported-speech conversion.
Regular verb forms: V1→V2 (-ed); V1→V3 (-ed); dance/danced, show/showed; choose correct past/past participle for regular verbs.
Irregular V1/V2/V3: go/went/gone, eat/ate/eaten, ring/rang/rung, take/took/taken; pick correct past or past participle; common TNPSC irregular list.
